claim.claim-text: 1. An apparatus comprising:

wherein the magnet is configured to activate a ferromagnetic lock distal to the flat surface when the suction cup activation element is in the first state, thereby reversibly attaching a panel to a support structure, wherein at least a portion of the panel is magnetically neutral.
2. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the ferromagnetic lock comprises an engaged position and a disengaged position, wherein the ferromagnetic lock comprises:
3. The apparatus of any one of claims 1 or 2 wherein the flat surface comprises a front surface of a photovoltaic panel.

4. The apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 3 further comprising a second suction cup and second suction cup case, and wherein in the first state the suction cup activation element is configured to cause the second suction cup to form a second vacuum with a flat surface opposing the second suction cup, and wherein in the second state to release the second vacuum.

5. The apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 4 wherein the magnet comprises an electromagnet, wherein the suction cup mechanism further comprises a button or a lever and a battery operative to activate the electromagnet.
6. The apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 5 wherein the magnet comprises a permanent magnet.
7. A system comprising:

a suction cup mechanism comprising: a handle, a magnet, a suction cup case attached to the handle, a suction cup held by the suction cup case, and a suction cup activation element comprising a first state and a second state,

wherein in the first state the suction cup activation element is configured to cause the suction cup to form a vacuum with a flat surface opposing the suction cup, and wherein in the second state to release the vacuum, wherein the magnet is configured to activate a ferromagnetic lock distal to the flat surface when the suction cup activation element is in the first state; and the ferromagnetic lock comprising: a first portion with ferromagnetic properties; a second portion configured to engage with a latch when in an engaged position; a hinge that hingedly connects the first portion and the second portion; and a locking mechanism disposed on a first side of a photovoltaic panel to be locked in place, at least a portion of the photovoltaic panel being magnetically neutral,

wherein the ferromagnetic lock comprises an engaged position and a disengaged position, wherein when the ferromagnetic lock is in the engaged position, the first portion is in a first position that forces the hingedly connected second portion to engage with the latch, and when the ferromagnetic lock is in the disengaged position, the first portion is in a second position that forces the hingedly connected second portion to disengage from the latch, thereby locking the locking mechanism.
8. The system of claim 7 wherein the flat surface comprises a front surface of a photovoltaic panel.

9. The system of any of claims 7 to 8 wherein the suction cup mechanism further comprises a second suction cup and second suction cup case, and wherein in the first state the suction cup activation element is configured to cause the second suction cup to form a second vacuum with the flat surface opposing the second suction cup, and wherein in the second state to release the second vacuum.

10. The system of any of claims 7 to 9 wherein the magnet comprises an electromagnet, wherein the suction cup mechanism further comprises a button or a lever and a battery operative to activate the electromagnet.
11. The system of any of claims 7 to 10 wherein the magnet comprises a permanent magnet.
12. The system of any of claims 7 to 11 wherein the flat surface comprises a front surface of a photovoltaic panel.

13. The system of any of claims 7 to 12, further comprising a solar panel, wherein the flat surface is the front surface of the solar panel, and the locking mechanism locks the solar panel to a support structure.
14. The system of any of claims 13, wherein at least one of:
the solar panel is used for generating electricity; and the solar panel is used for conversion of sunlight into heat for water heating.
15. The system any of claims 13 to 14, further comprising an electromagnet configured to be placed on a second side of the solar panel to unlock the locking mechanism.
